v18 — FULL ENGLISH + MIC TRUTH (owner's order). (1) LANGUAGE: the selected language now governs EVERYTHING — English selected means every screen, card and spoken line is in English: Settings, the Big Brain status and test, the console, mode lines, briefings and today-tasks, Voice ID prompts, update lines. Urdu selected keeps the Urdu text exactly as before. (2) MIC: if the phone takes the mic permission away, Dost no longer stays silent about it — a red banner appears at the top of the console with one button to fix it, and the Permissions (Health) screen now shows the truth: mic permission state, the mute switch AS THE SERVICE SEES IT, the last listening pass's mute action and the stream volumes before/after, and the last recognizer error. The 'Keep the mic sound muted' switch now applies LIVE (no restart needed), and the brief cue mute now covers MUSIC + SYSTEM sounds. (3) UPDATE LINE FIXED: Settings no longer offers you the version you have already installed. Permissions are exactly the same 16 — no new permission.

Urdu: (1) ZABAN: ab chuni hui zaban HAR cheez par laagu hai — English select hai to har screen, card aur boli hui line English mein hogi: Settings, Bara Dimagh ki halat aur test, console, mode lines, briefing aur aaj ke task, Voice ID, update lines. Urdu select karne par Urdu text waisa hi rahega. (2) MIC: agar phone mic ki permission wapas le le to Dost ab chup nahi rahega — console ke upar laal banner ayega jis par ek button se theek ho jayega, aur Permissions (Health) screen par sach dikhega: mic permission ki halat, mute switch jaisa service ko nazar aata hai, aakhri sun'ne wale pass ka mute action aur volume pehle/baad, aur aakhri recognizer error. 'Mic ki awaaz band rakho' switch ab LIVE laagu hota hai (restart nahi chahiye), aur mukhtasar mute ab MUSIC + SYSTEM dono awaazon par hai. (3) UPDATE LINE THEEK: Settings ab wo version offer nahi karega jo aap pehle hi install kar chuke hain. Permissions bilkul wahi 16 — koi nayi permission nahi.
